scope: Compare the horizontal SR10.4 VUE scrollbar and its normal endpoint arrows with the current installed GTK2 endpoint assets at native scale.

reference_vm.disk_identity: Canonical verifier passed; repository disk names resolve to the same inode.
reference_vm.isolation: The verifier also confirmed that the active Prancheta MAME process uses a distinct disk, network and control channel. No input was sent in this comparison.

temporary_full_capture.retention: Full guest screen stays in Tempia; it was not copied into the repository.

full_horizontal_bar.result: The newly captured VUE horizontal bar is pixel-identical to the retained SR10.4 normal-state raster at 1:1.

gtk2_route.mapping: Normal horizontal LEFT and RIGHT steppers use the two 15x15 overlay assets with overlay_stretch=FALSE.
gtk2_route.engine: When a matching STEPPER image draws successfully, domainos-pixbuf returns without painting a second ARROW image. The arrow is therefore the glyph already composed in the 15x15 cell.
gtk2_route.native_widget_evidence: The earlier isolated GTK 2.24.33 render of the installed theme (R473) measured both horizontal cells at 0/225 differences; R748 independently confirms the present installed assets still match the canonical cells.

result: The reported horizontal arrow-width reduction is not present in the current normal-state 15x15 GTK2 endpoint assets: both endpoint cells, including their glyphs and relief, match the measured SR10.4 artwork exactly. This result covers the normal raster and the prior isolated native render, not a newly captured horizontal scrollbar inside an open user GTK2 application.
limits: Only the normal state is covered here. Hover, held, insensitive and range-limit states remain separate.
The report does not compare the adjacent content frame or the 4px view-to-bar gap.
This comparison does not settle the user's separate concern about the long vertical trough's inner relief; R747 records that distinction.
changes: Copied only the 539x15 scrollbar crop into the durable record; no full desktop capture, guest text, source code, installed assets, palette, application or VM state was changed.
next: Continue GTK2-only by obtaining a same-session horizontal widget capture when one is visibly available; retain the present 15px stepper geometry unless that rendering provides contradictory evidence. Human acceptance of the long-trough relief remains pending.
